name: makeup-brush
description: A powder makeup brush with a full rounded bristle head and long narrow handle.
useCase: Identify powder brushes or makeup application tools.
misuse: Use a visible label when a tool identifies a product or a specific grooming task.

16.reason: The complete handle meets the bristle rim from outside, keeping both rounded caps out of the head opening.

24.reason: The larger brush keeps a broad bristle head and a full open handle.
